title: Wild AG
description: Warm paper-white and a pinker light surface, espresso ink and warm-grey text, with a taupe-to-sand brand gradient for bands, card panels and titles. Inter for running text and labels, Inria Serif italic for uppercase section titles; 16px corners, pills everywhere else, flat.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling in deep espresso with the same taupe and sand
primary is the taupe (gradient start), highlight the sand (gradient end): blocks paint the brand gradient as from-primary to-highlight
muted/card is the pinker light surface of whole bands and raised tiles; secondary is the sand used for media placeholders
border is the taupe at 25%, the colour of every hairline and pill outline
radius 16px; the bands' big bottom radius is computed from it (x3.4 on phones, x4.5 from 1024px)
gutter 18px on phones, 48px from 768px, 80px from 1024px; --page-width is the 1160px content column inside the gutters
